name: COSINE-100 Collaboration
notes: Host: Y2L until March 2023, Yemilab since (COSINE-100U). No roster or member count was found; the Atlas records no memberships.

summary.plain: The international team (Korean, US, UK, Brazilian, Indonesian and other institutions) that built and runs the COSINE-100 sodium-iodide dark-matter detector, designed to test DAMA/LIBRA's claimed dark-matter signal with the same target material.
summary.technical: COSINE-100 Collaboration: formed from the KIMS (Korea) and DM-Ice (US) groups, based at the IBS Center for Underground Physics, with institutions in Korea, the USA, the UK, Brazil and Indonesia on the 2018 detector paper; operated COSINE-100 at Y2L (2016-2023) and runs COSINE-100U at Yemilab. COSINE-200, a planned low-background upgrade, is described only as a possible next phase in the papers read.
